preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases must have a length between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABC' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s must consist only of the characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the string s can be fully erased, otherwise 'NO'.
